title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S06, the weapon rack
thread:
**Issue #3537 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3537: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S06, the weapon rack
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the weapon rack: the Drone Assemblers and the units that Discover a Weapon to equip.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #8 | Drone Assembler v3 |
| #9 | Drone Assembler v4 |
| #10 | Drone Assembler v5 |
| #60 | Radi |
| #159 | Raven |
| #160 | Icarus |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- Stinkyscape's weapon kit (M05), Drone Interceptor and Drone Corvette (S07), Discover and Equip

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- Drone Assemblers: "Target an enemy, summon a Drone Interceptor to attack it": the drone is summoned to its controller's side and attacks the chosen enemy at once, as Stinkyscape's drones do.
- #60 Radi, #159 Raven, #160 Icarus: "Discover 1 Rare (Epic, Legendary) Weapon; Equip it into this" offers three Weapons of that printed rarity.
- #160 Icarus: "Activate 1: Summon a Radi (trigger its Cry)": the Radi's Cry runs as if it was played.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(2) Drone Assembler v3, Unit, Rare, Weapon, Stinkyscape+, #8**
[0/2]
**Starship Piece**
**Equip**
**Activate 1:** Target an enemy, summon a **Drone Interceptor** to attack it
~~~
[0/4]
**Starship Piece**
**Equip**
**Activate 1:** Target an enemy, summon a **Radiant Drone Interceptor** to attack it

**(3) Drone Assembler v4, Unit, Epic, Weapon, Stinkyscape+, #9**
[0/3]
**Starship Piece**
**Equip**
**Activate 2:** Target an enemy, summon a **Drone Interceptor** to attack it
~~~
[0/6]
**Starship Piece**
**Equip**
**Activate 2:** Target an enemy, summon a **Radiant Drone Interceptor** to attack it

**(4) Drone Assembler v5, Unit, Legendary, Weapon, Stinkyscape+, #10**
[0/4]
**Starship Piece**
**Equip**
**Activate 1:** Target an enemy, summon a **Drone Corvette** to attack it
~~~
[0/8]
**Starship Piece**
**Equip**
**Activate 1:** Target an enemy, summon a **Radiant Drone Corvette** to attack it

**(2) Radi, Unit, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #60**
[1/1]
**Cry:** Discover 1 **Rare** **Weapons**; **Equip** them into this
~~~
[2/2]
**Cry:** Discover 1 **Epic** **Weapons**; **Equip** them into this

**(0) Raven, Unit, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #159**
[1/1]
**Tribute 1**
**Cry:** Discover 1 **Rare** **Weapons**; **Equip** them into this
~~~
[2/2]
**Tribute 1**
**Cry:** Discover 1 **Epic** **Weapons**; **Equip** them into this

**(4) Icarus, Unit, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #160**
**Tribute 3**
[2/8]
**Activate 1:** Summon a **Radi** *{trigger it’s cry}*
**Cry:** Discover a **Epic** **Weapons**; **Equip** it into this
~~~
**Tribute 3**
[4/16]
**Activate 1:** Summon a **Radiant** **Radi** *{trigger it’s cry}*
**Cry:** Discover a **Legendary** **Weapons**; **Equip** it into this
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3535

Part of #3534.
````
